headline: 今日无新片 电影剧集热度混战
headlineEn: No New Releases Today; Film & TV Heat Mixes
summary: 今日无新片上映，本周仅1部新片；电影端《天启Z：新世界》热度领先，剧集端《末路兼职》《Lupin》表现抢眼，整体由热门片剧主导。
summaryEn: No new films opened today and only one arrived this week; Apocalypse Z: The New World leads movie heat, while Dead-End Part-Time Job and Lupin drive TV buzz.

industryHighlights.text: 今日电影市场零新片上映，本周仅新增1部电影。
industryHighlights.en: Zero films opened today, with only one new movie this week.

industryHighlights.text: 《天启Z：新世界》领跑今日电影热度榜。
industryHighlights.en: Apocalypse Z: The New World leads today's movie heat.

industryHighlights.text: 《末路兼职》与《嗜血法医：杀魔复生》占据今日剧集热度前列。
industryHighlights.en: Dead-End Part-Time Job and Dexter: Resurrection top today's TV heat.

industryHighlights.text: 《Lupin》与《不存在的罪人》分列本周剧集、电影热度首位。
industryHighlights.en: Lupin and The Nonexistent Sinner lead this week's TV and movie heat, respectively.

industryHighlights.text: 近期待映片单暂无重点新作。
industryHighlights.en: No notable upcoming releases are on the horizon.
